mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification (member_id, kind, level, title, text, link, notice_key) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{kind}, #{level}, #{title}, #{text}, #{link}, #{noticeKey}) ON CONFLICT (member_id, notice_key) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT notification_id AS id, kind, level, title, text, link, to_char(read_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS read_at, to_char(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS created_at FROM notification WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, notification_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND read_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE notification SET read_at = COALESCE(read_at, NOW()) WHERE notification_id = #{notificationId} AND member_id = #{memberId}
UPDATE notification SET read_at = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND read_at IS NULL
